flagged.reason: The video displays the incorrect English word 'Mundane' for the head-shaving rite Mundan, which would penalize students on terminology.

flagged.title: Karma, Reincarnation, Varna and Hindu Festivals
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly contrasts Vaishnava Diwali celebration with Shakta celebration by attributing Lakshmi worship to Shaktas instead of broad Vaishnava practice/Kali Puja, which would cost marks on GCSE questions testing diversity of tradition.

mark_affecting.quote: But on the right we have the Shaktas, the devotees of the goddess. For them, Diwali is deeply associated with Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
